title: Geometric Observables for Financial Regime Detection
abstract: arXiv:2605.17117v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We extract four geometric observables -- Berry Phase Rate, Spectral Entropy, Reduced State Purity, and Hamiltonian Sensitivity -- from a learned spectral embedding of equity-index returns and evaluate them as regime-shift detectors against 46 classical and machine-learning baselines on 17 historical crises spanning 2000-2024. Under walk-forward nested hyperparameter selection on nine labelled windows, the Berry Phase Rate achieves an unbiased out-of-sample median Cohen's $d = 0.72$ (95% percentile-bootstrap CI $[0.34, 1.18]$, 10,000 resamples) and produces approximately 67% fewer false alarms per year than a label-supervised Random Forest (1.2 vs. 3.6 per year). Reduced State Purity attains the highest in-sample separability of any method ($d = 0.83$), tied closely by the Absorption Ratio ($d = 0.80$); geometric and classical channels are largely uncorrelated (mean $|\rho| \approx 0.22$), suggesting they capture distinct risk signals

translated_title: 用于金融市场状态检测的几何可观测量
translated_abstract: 我们从股指收益的学习谱嵌入中提取了四种几何可观测量——贝里相位率、谱熵、约化态纯度和哈密顿灵敏度，并在2000至2024年间的17次历史危机中，将其作为市场状态转换检测器与46种经典及机器学习基线方法进行对比评估。在九个标注窗口上采用向前滚动嵌套超参数选择的条件下，贝里相位率取得了无偏的样本外中位数Cohen's d = 0.72（95%百分位自助法置信区间为[0.34, 1.18]，10,000次重采样），且每年产生的误报比有标签监督的随机森林少约67%（每年1.2次对3.6次）。约化态纯度在所有方法中取得了最高的样本内可分性（d = 0.83），吸收比率紧随其后（d = 0.80）；几何通道与经典通道在很大程度上互不相关（平均|ρ| ≈ 0.22），表明二者捕捉的是不同的风险信号。
tldr: 该研究提出从股指收益谱嵌入中提取的四种几何可观测量可作为有效的金融市场状态转换检测器，其误报率显著低于监督学习基线，且与经典风险指标捕捉的信号互补。
en_tdlr: Four geometric observables extracted from learned spectral embeddings of equity returns serve as effective financial regime-shift detectors with fewer false alarms than supervised baselines, capturing risk signals complementary to classical indicators.
